title: lysimachia monelli subsp. linifolia
intro: Lysimachia monelli subsp. linifolia, commonly known as the golden dropwort, is a plant species belonging to the primrose family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to aid in reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity, thereby providing health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lysimachia monelli subsp. linifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
